scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

arguments.command:
find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f
' | sort; echo count=$(find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l); sed -n '1,4p' scripts/*; printf '
--- verify/install mode ---
'; ls -l verify.py install-scripts.sh

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for path in sorted(Path('scripts').iterdir()):
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    data = path.read_bytes()
    expected = b'#!/bin/bash\n'
    if not data.startswith(expected):
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: missing expected shebang')
    if data.startswith(expected + b'set -euo pipefail\n'):
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: setting already present')
    path.write_bytes(expected + b'set -euo pipefail\n' + data[len(expected):])
PY
python3 verify.py
